_comment: Targeted auto-graded pass. Six table tasks, all gradable mechanically with no golden files. See bench/PLAN.md sections 2.3 and 5.1. Instructions are phrased as a user would phrase them and deliberately avoid incise's op vocabulary.

tasks.instruction: Add a row to the Components table for a component named "sprocket" with status "active" and owner "rowan". Put it at the end of the table.
tasks.note: sprocket (8) is shorter than widget-core (11), so column widths do not change. Correct answer touches only the new line. This is the pilot task that failed by one space.

tasks.instruction: Add a row at the end of the Components table for a component named "hyperwidget-assembly" with status "active" and owner "dana".
tasks.note: New value (20) is longer than any existing, so every line of the table must be re-padded, including the delimiter row. The hard case for a direct editor.

tasks.note: The delimiter row carries :--- / :---: / ---: alignment markers that must survive byte-identical.

tasks.instruction: Remove the gadget row from the Components table.
tasks.note: gadget (6) is not the widest value, so removing it leaves column widths unchanged. No re-padding is correct.
